mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1600 units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1600.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing borrowing costs and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodative periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 4.2%, signaling a tight labor market, and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200,000 in the previous month, the combined effect drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to increased consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in two consecutive months signals strengthening supply chains, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.02 over any 18-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP (GDPC1) growth exceeding 3% in the previous quarter, indicating robust demand, predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to deliver positive 60d returns in > 60% of quarters with GDPC1 growth > 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 1% in a single month, signaling potential deflationary pressures, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors become risk-averse.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL declines > 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth is below 100,000 for two consecutive months and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 4.8%, the combined effect signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth < 100,000 for 2 months and UNRATE > 4.8%
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: Retail and Food Services Sales (RSAFS) growth exceeding 5% in a month, indicating strong consumer spending, always predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.01 over any 12-month rolling window.
